dyson_big_ball.text: The manufacturer views show a separate rounded canister on the floor connected to a flexible hose and long rigid wand. Look for that whole arrangement. A floorhead or hose by itself cannot distinguish the machine family.
dyson_big_ball.basis: Native comparison of the source-labelled manufacturer reference views in reference_pack.json; descriptive visual cues, not a claim of uniqueness.

dyson_v12_detect_slim.text: The manufacturer views show a compact straight inline dust bin under the cyclone/motor, a round rear display and a red power button on top. Compare bin proportions and control placement with V15. A green-lit floorhead and purple/gold colour alone do not separate V12, V15 and other Dyson families.
dyson_v12_detect_slim.basis: Native comparison of the source-labelled manufacturer reference views in reference_pack.json; descriptive visual cues, not a claim of uniqueness.

dyson_v15_detect.text: The manufacturer views show a larger inline clear dust bin projecting below the motor/cyclones, a pistol grip and round rear display. Compare the grip/control area and bin proportions with V12. Similar illumination, attachments and colours occur on other Dyson models; absent or hidden controls do not establish a contradiction.
dyson_v15_detect.basis: Native comparison of the source-labelled manufacturer reference views in reference_pack.json; descriptive visual cues, not a claim of uniqueness.

dyson_v16_piston_animal.text: Compare the manufacturer views of the long inline bin, its external compression mechanism, tall rear motor/filter section and cleaner-head geometry. A cleaner head alone is weak evidence because accessories can be detached or changed. Do not identify this family from wand colour alone.
dyson_v16_piston_animal.basis: Native comparison of the source-labelled manufacturer reference views in reference_pack.json; descriptive visual cues, not a claim of uniqueness.

dyson_v8_absolute.text: The manufacturer views show the clear dust bin arranged across/below the motor rather than the long straight inline bin of V12 and V15, with a pistol grip behind it. Check the whole motor-bin-grip arrangement. Other older Dyson families can share this layout, so it is not sufficient proof by itself.
dyson_v8_absolute.basis: Native comparison of the source-labelled manufacturer reference views in reference_pack.json; descriptive visual cues, not a claim of uniqueness.

dyson_wash_g1.text: The manufacturer views show an upright hard-floor cleaner with a long curved handle, two vertically arranged liquid tanks and a broad low cleaning base. Compare the tank and handle arrangement. A close-up of rollers or the cleaning base alone may be insufficient to distinguish wet cleaners.
dyson_wash_g1.basis: Native comparison of the source-labelled manufacturer reference views in reference_pack.json; descriptive visual cues, not a claim of uniqueness.
